finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful advantage over base and donor rivals is excluded under both interval methods; pooled advantage remains unresolved under both. Primary uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, with intervals including zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, and performance is worse than uniform only under writer resampling. Raw base, pooled and donor useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text without adding personal information. Sparse histories, calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. First eight-epoch seed remains outage-interrupted, unknown and unscored; no cross-seed eight-epoch comparison. No independent human confirmation, epoch ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
